simple.meaning: בְּרִיחַ (bᵉrîyach) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a bolt.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 42 times across Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Samuel, and 13 more, beginning at Exodus 26:26. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בְּרִיחַ (H1280).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H1280. beriach בְּרִיחַ noun masculine bar (compare Assyrian burû—u , spearshaft , spear , COT Gloss ) — בְּרִיחַ Deut 3:5 11 t. (construct Amos 1:5 etc.); בְּרִיחוֺ Exod 35:11 ; 39:38 Kt (Qr both חַֿיו needless); plural בְּרִיחִם 26:26 8 t., בְּרִיחִים 2Chr 14:6 , בְּרִיחֵי Exod 36:31 3 t., בְּרִיחָ֑יִךְ Nahum 3:13 , בְּרִיחָיו Exod 40:18 7 t. (+ Qr 35:11 ; 39:33 ), בְּרִיחֶיהָ Jer 51:30 ; Lam 2:9 , בְּרִחֶיהָ Jonah 2:7 , בְּרִיחֶ֑הָ Isa 15:5 but compare below; — 1. a. bar , of wood, joining boards of tabernacle Exod 26:26-27 , (twice in verse); 26:28-29 , (twice in verse); 35:11 ; 36:31-32 , (twice in verse); 36:33-34 , (twice in verse); 40:18 ; Num 3:36 ; 4:31 (all P). b. bar ( s ) of city-gates Deut 3:5 ; Judg 16:8 ; 1Sam 23:7 ; 2Chr 8:5 ; 14:6 ; id. of gates of Jerusalem Lam 2:9 ; also (|| מנעולים ) Neh 3:3 , 6 , 18 , 14 , 15 compare Psa 147:13 ; compare Amos 1:5 ; Nahum 3:13 ; Jer 49:31 ; Ezek 38:11 ; Jer 51:30 ; bars of city-gates, ׳ב נחשׁת 1Kin 4:13 , ׳ב ברזל Isa 45:2 (of Babylon, broken before Cyrus); בְּרִיחֶ֑הָ 15:5 read probably with ᵑ7 Di and others ׳בָּר see בָּרִיחַ ; yet compare Che's critical note 2 figurative ׳ב בַּרְזָל of distress, etc. Psa 107:16 ; of fortress, ׳ב אַרְמוֺן in simile Prov 18:19 ; figurative ׳ב of earth (pictured as house out of which Jonah is shut) Jonah 2:7 . (Older usage singular of bar of door or gate, i.e. the great bar across the gate; so Deut 3:5 ; Judg 16:3 ; Amos 1:5 ; 1Sam 23:7 ; 1Kin 4:13 ; Jer 49:31 ; Prov 18:9 ; Job 38:10 ; 2Chr 8:5 ; Ezek 38:11 Later plural Isa 45:2 ; Lam 2:9 ; 2Chr 14:6 ; Neh 3:3 , 6 , 13 , 14 , 15 ; Psa 147:13 , but also Nahum 3:13 .)
